description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for managing restaurant entities in a food delivery backend. It includes endpoints to list all restaurants, create a new restaurant, and list restaurants owned by the current user. It leverages SQLAlchemy ORM models and dependencies for authentication and database session management.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance used to define endpoints related to restaurants.

methods.name: list[RestaurantResponse] list_restaurants(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all restaurants with public access.

methods.name: RestaurantResponse create_restaurant( payload: RestaurantCreateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner: User = Depends(require_role(UserRole.restaurant)), )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new restaurant; restricted to users with restaurant role.

methods.name: list[RestaurantResponse] list_my_restaurants( db: Session = Depends(get_db), owner: User = Depends(require_role(UserRole.restaurant)), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list restaurants owned by the authenticated user.
